 IndiGo Marks Two Years of IndiGo Stretch with Over 4,000 Daily Seats Across its Growing 
 Aviation Jeta 
 |
 Posted on November 16, 2026 
 |
 2 min read |
 IndiGo has completed two years of offering its custom-made business product, IndiGoStretch, in the market. IndiGo operated its first flight with an IndiGoStretch cabin on 14 November 2024 from Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai. Backed by encouraging demand, the offering has expanded over the past two years with the airline offering more than 4,000 IndiGoStretch seats across 12 domestic and 24 international routes. The continued expansion also reflects evolving customer expectations and the rising demand for differentiated, premium travel experiences while reinforcing IndiGo’s commitment to making business travel more accessible, purposeful and value driven.
 IndiGo has a growing fleet of over 65 narrow-body aircraft with dual-class configuration today. In the Domestic market, IndiGoStretch is available across major metro connections linking Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and Kolkata, alongside select routes to Pune and Goa. On short-haul international sectors, IndiGoStretch is offered on select routes connecting India with destinations including Bangkok, Dubai, Singapore, Bali, Hanoi, Phuket, Hong Kong, and Mauritius. Effective 01 December 2026, IndiGo will offer IndiGoStretch on Mumbai–Malé flights. Additionally, on medium to long-haul routes, IndiGoStretch is available on the A321XLR services connecting India with Istanbul, Amsterdam and Athens.
 Aloke Singh, Chief Strategy Officer, IndiGo, said , “India’s travel market is evolving rapidly, and with it, customer expectations. We see clear demand for premium experiences that offer greater comfort and convenience without compromising on value. IndiGoStretch responds to that opportunity, and its continued expansion reflects the strong customer response we’ve seen. As we grow, we will continue to broaden our offering and elevate the travel experience, while staying true to the affordability, reliability and operational excellence that define IndiGo.” 
 IndiGo’s business cabin offers spacious recliner-style seating, dedicated overhead bin space, in-seat charging, thoughtfully curated complimentary meals and beverages, and priority services across the travel journeys. Customers seeking additional flexibility and convenience can also opt for Stretch+, which builds on this experience with additional benefits such as additional baggage allowance, hassle-free cancellation, and complimentary lounge access.
 As the product enters its third year, IndiGo plans to continue expanding its presence across key domestic and international markets in line with the airline’s growing network and customer demand.
